instruction.name: vssrlrni.du.q
instruction.description: Logical right shift with rounding the unsigned 128-bit elements in `a` and `b` by `imm`, saturate the result to unsigned 64-bit, write the 64-bit results into `dst`.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 3.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
